title: First band with Josiah, Lawrence and friends; Oil for Sale, 1924
summary: The group Eddie started with is named: Josiah on drums, Raymond Brown on trombone, Bush Hall on cornet, Lawrence on banjo. They played together in 1924 before parting.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Well, we started together. It was Josiah on drum. Uh-huh. Uh-huh. Raymond Brown on trambone. Bushall on the corner of his age. And, um, Lawrence on the bench. Oh yeah, Louis Conqueror was named. From a boy.

I got to him, yeah. Louis. Then we took an oil for sale in the band. That's way back in 1924. Oil for sale, Lawrence, my rival, and me. We played together three times. Treat this and then. So we parted when we got. And the ladies there, they kept on and I stopped. So around four to six I went back. You stopped playing music?
